Row.Text: Creates one Great Work of Writing: Yongle Encyclopedia. On first acquisition, triggers every available technology Eureka. Provides +10 [ICON_Culture] Culture, +500 [ICON_Science] Science and +10 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism per turn.
A Ming dynasty scholar and chief compiler of the Yongle Encyclopedia. In this mod, his encyclopedia is the origin of everything: a single Great Work of Writing with extraordinary scientific value.

The origin of everything, gathered in one compendium.[NEWLINE]On first acquisition by each civilization, triggers every available technology Eureka.[NEWLINE]+10 [ICON_Culture] Culture, +500 [ICON_Science] Science, +10 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism per turn.

Even a surviving page can spark inspiration.[NEWLINE]On first acquisition by each civilization, triggers up to 5 different, unearned technology Eurekas from the current era.[NEWLINE]+50 [ICON_Science] Science, +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture, +3 [ICON_Faith] Faith, +2 [ICON_Tourism] Tourism per turn.
创建1部文学巨作《永乐大典》。首次获取时触发全部可用科技的尤里卡。每回合+10 [ICON_Culture]文化值、+500 [ICON_Science]科技值、+10 [ICON_Tourism]旅游业绩。
明代学者、《永乐大典》的主要编纂者之一。本模组以“万物起源：永乐大典”为梗，让他创作一部具有非凡科技产出的文学巨作。
钦定大典，纂辑万物起源。[NEWLINE]每个文明首次获取此巨作时，触发全部可用科技的尤里卡。[NEWLINE]每回合+10 [ICON_Culture]文化值、+500 [ICON_Science]科技值、+10 [ICON_Tourism]旅游业绩。
残篇亦可窥全豹，偶得灵光之启。[NEWLINE]每个文明首次获取此文物时，随机触发当前时代最多5项不同且尚未获得的科技尤里卡。[NEWLINE]每回合+50 [ICON_Science]科技值、+1 [ICON_Culture]文化值、+3 [ICON_Faith]信仰值、+2 [ICON_Tourism]旅游业绩。
